data.question: Jumlah penduduk miskin di Jawa Barat berapa ribu jiwa?

value.raw_question: Jumlah penduduk miskin di Jawa Barat berapa ribu jiwa?

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, SUM(T3.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
INNER JOIN nilai_indikator AS T3 ON T1.kode = T3.kode_provinsi
INNER JOIN indikator AS T2 ON T3.kode_indikator = T2.kode
WHERE T2.kode_kanonik = 'penduduk miskin' AND T3.periode = :periode AND T3.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 100;  -- Adjust the LIMIT as needed

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(nilai) AS jumlah_penduduk FROM nilai_indikator
WHERE kode_indikator = :indikator
AND periode = :periode
AND kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0);

SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  periode,
  SUM(nilai) AS jumlah_penduduk_miskin
FROM
  nilai_indikator
JOIN
  provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  provinsi.nama,
  periode
ORDER BY
  nilai_penduduk_miskin DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode AS periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
    JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) / 1000000 AS nilai 
FROM provinsi 
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi 
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator 
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode 
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama;
